definitions.explanation: A work of art, literature, film, or other creative endeavor that is considered outstanding in quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{秀作|しゅうさく}だ。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画祭|えいがさい}→映画祭：30642_eigasai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{秀作|しゅうさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many fine works at this year's film festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{秀作|しゅうさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: An excellent piece was selected from among the many submitted works.

notes:
Composed of {秀|しゅう} (excellent, outstanding) + ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (work, production). Used to praise creative works such as novels, films, paintings, and other artistic products. Slightly more formal than simply saying ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秀作|しゅうさく}ぞろい: a collection of excellent works
- {秀作|しゅうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}す→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧: to produce an excellent work
- ⟦{隠|かく}れた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧{秀作|しゅうさく}: a hidden gem

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧: masterpiece — implies an even higher level of achievement, a truly exceptional work, while {秀作|しゅうさく} is more moderate praise meaning 'very good'
- ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧: famous work, classic — emphasizes renown and lasting reputation, while {秀作|しゅうさく} focuses on quality regardless of fame
- ⟦{力作|りきさく}→力作：16208_rikisaku⟧: ambitious work — emphasizes the effort put into creating the work rather than the quality of the result
